text:
lina: FYI - I'm proposing changes to the audit event contract to address customer requests around IP and session handling. We need to version and validate before rollout.

mattg: +1. Can you list the fields being added/removed?

lina: Adding `actor.ip` and `resource.location` (nullable). Removing `actor_session_id` — customers asked we stop emitting persistent session ids. :eyes:

raj: Is removing actor_session_id a breaking change for internal tooling? Search/index uses it.

sasha: It is used in devex logs. We should keep a mapping for 90 days or emit a compatibility field.

lina: Proposal: keep current payload as v2 for 30 days, start emitting v3 with new fields and a top-level `schema.version`. v2->v3 migration window = 30 days. Canary first, then gradual.

jen: +1 on schema.version. Also we need a customer-facing notice and an opt-in preview for enterprise tenants (so they can validate their sinks).

lina: Validation plan: preflight mode that mirrors customer's endpoint -> run sample events through our validator; add schema checks to platform CI and an integration test harness for major customers.

mattg: Can you paste the minimal v3 snippet so infra can wire up validators?

lina: ```json
{
  "schema.version": "v3",
  "timestamp": "2026-11-03T14:22:00Z",
  "actor": {"id":"user_123","ip":"203.0.113.42","type":"user"},
  "resource": {"id":"model-abc","type":"model","location":null},
  "action": "model.deploy"
}
```

raj: For migration: keep `actor_session_id` present in v2 until cutoff, and emit `actor.session_ref` in v3 (hashed). Also add a deprecation header `X-Audit-Schema-Deprecation: v2-2026-12-15` when sending v3 to internal services so they can flag uses.

sasha: Who owns the customer validation emails and doc updates?

jen: I'll own docs and coordinated notice. I can draft the enterprise preview sign-up flow. @lina can you draft the customer sample payloads and a one-pager? :thumbsup:

lina: Yup, will draft today and post samples to the docs repo. Also adding a short migration checklist for SRE and platform teams.

ops-bot: created ticket INC-2026-1432 (audit-schema-change) and assigned to lina

mattg: Let's set a canary: enable v3 only for 5% of hosted traffic for 7 days, capture validation failures and increase to 25% if stable.

lina: Agreed. I'll update rollout plan, add metrics to track (validation_failures, downstream_400s, consumer_errors) and post PR for schema validator by EOD. Thanks everyone.
